title: Accounting for intra-household joint travel in agent-based transport simulations
abstract: arXiv:2608.18657v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intra-household joint home-based tours - trips in which household members depart together, engage in shared activities, and return together - represent a significant share of daily travel, yet are systematically ignored in transport simulations. Conflating joint and solo tours within a single mode choice framework introduces bias in preference parameter estimates. This paper proposes a three-step methodology to integrate joint tours in agent-based transport models: a Random Forest classifier to identify joint tours, a Multinomial Logit model estimating mode choice specific to joint tours, and a Penalized Logistic Regression for driver/passenger assignment. Applied to the Paris region using household travel survey data, the methodology successfully replicates observed joint tour shares and mode distributions in a synthetic population. translated_title: 在基于代理的交通模拟中考虑家庭内部联合出行
translated_abstract: 摘要：家庭内部联合家庭出行——即家庭成员一起出发、共同参与活动并一起返回的行程——在日常出行中占据重要比例，但在交通模拟中却系统性被忽视。将联合出行和单独出行混在单一出行方式选择框架中，会导致偏好参数估计出现偏差。本文提出了一种三步方法，将联合出行整合到基于代理的交通模型中：使用随机森林分类器识别联合出行，用多项Logit模型估计联合出行特有的出行方式选择，以及用惩罚逻辑回归进行驾驶员/乘客分配。该方法应用于巴黎地区，使用家庭出行调查数据，成功在合成人群中复现了观察到的联合出行份额和方式分布。所提出的框架能够更可靠地评估对联合和单独出行影响不同的政策。
tldr: 本文提出一种三步方法，通过机器学习分类器和离散选择模型将家庭联合出行整合到基于代理的交通模拟中，以提高政策评估的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a three-step method integrating household joint tours into agent-based transport simulations using machine learning classifiers and discrete choice models, enhancing policy evaluation reliability.
